description: Static, hand-curated list of major India-Pakistan wars, standoffs, and turning-point conflicts, 1947 to present. This file is NOT auto-updated by the daily script — update manually when a new major event occurs.
sources: Wikipedia: List of wars involving Pakistan
News archives (Dawn, BBC, Reuters) for post-2016 events

events.name: First Kashmir War
events.summary: Fighting broke out after tribal militias backed by Pakistan entered Jammu and Kashmir following Partition, prompting the Maharaja's accession to India and the deployment of Indian troops. Ended with a UN-brokered ceasefire and the creation of the Line of Control.

events.name: Rann of Kutch Skirmish
events.summary: A border clash in the Rann of Kutch marshlands preceded the larger 1965 war, resolved via international arbitration.

events.name: Second Kashmir War
events.summary: Triggered by Pakistan's Operation Gibraltar, an attempt to spark insurgency in Kashmir. Ended in a ceasefire and the 1966 Tashkent Agreement restoring the pre-war status quo.

events.name: Indo-Pakistani War of 1971 / Bangladesh Liberation War
events.summary: Triggered by the Bengali independence movement and a Pakistani military crackdown in East Pakistan. Ended with the surrender of Pakistan's Eastern Command and the creation of Bangladesh.

events.name: Siachen Conflict
events.summary: A long-running military standoff over control of the Siachen Glacier, among the highest-altitude conflicts in the world. Effectively ended with a 2003 ceasefire, though troops remain deployed.

events.name: Kargil War
events.summary: Pakistani forces and militants infiltrated Indian-administered positions in Kargil. India launched Operation Vijay to reclaim territory; ended with Pakistani withdrawal under international pressure.

events.name: India-Pakistan Military Standoff
events.summary: Mass troop mobilization by both countries following the December 2001 attack on the Indian Parliament, de-escalated through diplomatic engagement without direct war.

events.name: 2008 India-Pakistan Standoff
events.summary: Heightened tensions and troop movements following the November 2008 Mumbai attacks, which India attributed to Pakistan-based militants.

events.name: Uri Attack and Indian Surgical Strikes
events.location: Uri, Jammu and Kashmir / Line of Control
events.summary: After an attack on an Indian army base in Uri, India conducted what it described as surgical strikes on militant launch pads across the Line of Control.

events.name: 2016-2018 India-Pakistan Border Skirmishes
events.summary: A sustained period of cross-border firing and skirmishes along the Line of Control, with periodic escalations and civilian and military casualties on both sides.

events.name: Pulwama Attack and Balakot Airstrike
events.summary: A suicide bombing in Pulwama killed Indian paramilitary personnel; India responded with airstrikes on an alleged militant camp in Balakot, Pakistan, followed by an aerial engagement and a captured Indian pilot's release.

events.name: 2019 India-Pakistan Border Skirmishes
events.summary: Continued periodic cross-border firing incidents along the Line of Control through the year.

events.name: 2020-2021 India-Pakistan Border Skirmishes
events.summary: Cross-border firing continued until both militaries agreed to a renewed ceasefire understanding on the Line of Control in February 2021.

events.name: 2023 India-Pakistan Border Skirmishes
events.summary: Sporadic ceasefire violations and skirmishes reported along the Line of Control.

events.name: 2025 India-Pakistan Conflict (Operation Sindoor)
events.summary: India launched missile strikes inside Pakistan in early May 2025, described by India as Operation Sindoor, leading to several days of cross-border military exchanges before a ceasefire was reached.
